title: Split into Chunks
hints: `stride(from:to:by:)` generates the start index of every chunk.
Map each start index to a slice, clamping the end with `min` so the last chunk doesn't go out of bounds.
`stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: size).map { Array(items[$0 ..< min($0 + size, items.count)]) }`.
